summary.one_liner: uvloop is a fast, drop-in replacement for the built-in asyncio event loop, implemented in Cython on top of libuv.
summary.what_it_does: uvloop replaces the default asyncio event loop with one built on libuv, aiming to make asyncio faster without changing application code. The README says it makes asyncio 2-4x faster, citing an echo-server benchmark that compares raw sockets, asyncio streams, and protocol-based servers. It provides a uvloop.run() helper that wraps asyncio.run() to use uvloop and passes through arguments such as debug. For Python 3.11 and earlier, it documents an asyncio.Runner with loop_factory=uvloop.new_event_loop, or uvloop.install() on older versions. The project is installable from PyPI and can be built from source with a dev install and a test target.
use_cases: drop-in faster event loop for asyncio apps
high-throughput echo or socket servers in Python
reduce latency of async Python I/O
notable: Drop-in replacement for the asyncio event loop, so existing asyncio code can switch with minimal changes
Built on libuv, the same event-loop library underlying Node.js
uvloop.run() helper configures asyncio.run() to use uvloop
Documented benchmarks comparing sockets, streams, and protocol echo servers
caveats: Building from source needs a git clone with submodules, a virtualenv, and a make step
